Introduction

She’Z was a three-member South Korean K-pop and Dance-pop girl group formed by independent company, Line Entertainment and Sony Music Entertainment. They made their official debut on the 17th of May, 2012, with the digital single “She’z Holic” with the title track "My Way" as four members; Jina, Seyeon, Jiyoung and Taeyeon. In 2014, the group released their last single, "Another Day is Passing".

Before their debut, they performed together on the soundtrack of the drama Scent of a Woman, releasing the song "Better Tomorrow" in 2011, despite not yet being an official group. They gained popularity through their industry connections, excellent singing and performance skills. Also before debut, Jina and Taeyeon were appointed as MCs with Shin Dong Yup, they were aswell confirmed as supporting MCs for Channel Q's ‘Miracle on 7th Street.’. Taeyeon, earlier in 2012, was featured on a track by Lee Hyunwook.

Despite releasing four singles in 2013 and 2014, little to no promotion was done, and the group's activities became nearly nonexistent. Over time, Jina gradually stopped appearing on the group's social media channels, leading to speculation that she left the group sometime in 2014. On December 9, 2015, member Jiyoung debuted as a soloist with the digital single, "Love Is The Key". The three remaining members stayed active on social media until early 2016. The group was believed to have disbanded later that year, as members removed references to the group or deleted their accounts. Years later, Jiyoung confirmed the disbandment on Instagram, adding that she was dismissed from Line Entertainment before it happened.
